title: Delicious Weeknight Pregnancy Menus: 5 Cook-Once Recipes
excerpt: Five flavorful recipes for busy evenings — soup, stir-fry, egg dishes and yogurt parfaits — balanced for protein, fiber and calcium.
content:
## Introduction
When pregnant, eating a balanced and nutritious diet is crucial for the health of both mother and baby. However, with busy schedules, many pregnant women struggle to prepare healthy and delicious meals. In this article, we will introduce 5 cook-once recipes that provide pregnant women with nutritious and tasty weeknight meals.

## Nutrient Analysis
The recipes below are selected based on the principle of balanced nutrition, including protein, fiber, and calcium. According to the [WHO](https://www.who.int/tools/elena/interventions/nutrition-counselling-pregnancy), nutrition during pregnancy plays a vital role in the development of the fetus and the health of the mother.

## 5 Cook-Once Recipes
### 1. Chicken Soup with Vegetables
Chicken soup is a nutritious and easy-to-digest meal. To cook chicken soup, you need:
- 1 chicken
- 2 carrots
- 2 potatoes
- 1 onion
- 2 tablespoons olive oil
- Salt and pepper

Cooking chicken soup with vegetables provides a large amount of protein, fiber, and vitamins.

### 2. Chicken Stir-Fry with Spinach
Chicken stir-fry with spinach is an excellent choice for dinner. To cook this dish, you need:
- 1 chicken
- 1 bunch of spinach
- 2 tablespoons olive oil
- Salt and pepper

Chicken stir-fry with spinach provides protein, fiber, and vitamins.

### 3. Poached Eggs with Salad
Poached eggs are a nutritious and easy-to-make meal. To cook poached eggs, you need:
- 2 eggs
- 1 tablespoon olive oil
- Salt and pepper
- Salad (lettuce, tomatoes, cucumbers)

Poached eggs with salad provide protein, fiber, and vitamins.

### 4. Yogurt Parfait with Fruit
Yogurt parfait is a delicious and nutritious meal. To make yogurt parfait, you need:
- 1 cup yogurt
- 1 cup fruit (strawberries, bananas, oranges)
- 1 tablespoon granola

Yogurt parfait with fruit provides calcium, protein, and fiber.

### 5. Chicken and Vegetable Fried Rice
Chicken and vegetable fried rice is a nutritious and easy-to-make meal. To cook chicken and vegetable fried rice, you need:
- 1 chicken
- 2 carrots
- 2 potatoes
- 1 onion
- 2 tablespoons olive oil
- Salt and pepper

Chicken and vegetable fried rice provide protein, fiber, and vitamins.

## Practical Tips
To ensure food safety, you should:
- Wash your hands before preparing meals
- Wash vegetables before cooking
- Cook food to a safe temperature
- Store food in the refrigerator

You can learn more about [pregnancy meal planning](/blog/pregnancy-meal-planner) and [prenatal nutrition](/blog/topics/prenatal-nutrition) on our website.

## When to Seek Help
If you have any questions or concerns about nutrition during pregnancy, you should consult your doctor or a registered dietitian.
